title: Canonical Indian Instrument v2
description: Versioned wire contract (P1-02). v2 covers NSE/BSE cash equities and ETFs only. InstrumentId is the canonical platform identity and is never derived from a symbol, token, ISIN, or broker key. Each listing owns its own settlement regime, Z-category designation and exchange terms with validity intervals. Trading terms carry the assigned tick (NSE monthly assignment record) as ingested data, never a guessed constant or a live band lookup. Futures, options, currency pairs, bonds, and indices use separate versioned contracts. v1 is frozen; do not edit it to match.

instrument_id.description: Canonical platform identity for the instrument. Stable, lowercase, independent of symbols, ISIN, tokens, and broker keys.

instrument_type.description: Supported type for this contract version. Other asset families require their own versioned contracts.

isin.description: External instrument identifier where issued. Required for this contract; format here, ISO 6166 check digit enforced by the Rust ingress boundary.

listings.description: Venue admissions for this instrument. Symbols are scoped here, never identity.

corporate_actions.description: Embedded action history. This array is not a point-in-time event ledger; source provenance and knowledge time belong to the future corporate-action event contract.

venue.description: Venue (exchange). Broker identities are never venues.

segment.description: Market segment. This contract version covers cash equities only.

venue_symbol.description: Trading symbol scoped to this venue and segment; not identity.

token.description: Venue-assigned token for this listing (exchange token, never a broker instrument key).

effective_from.description: First date this listing is valid, inclusive.

effective_to.description: Last date this listing is valid, inclusive. Null means open-ended.

settlement_regime.description: Settlement regime while tradable (NSE EQ standard; NSE BE trade-for-trade). Never a trading status.

z_category.description: Whether the exchange designates the security as Z-category (NSE BZ series): trade-for-trade with added restrictions. Distinct from trading status.

settlement_group.description: Venue settlement group (BSE Group Name) in force for this listing; part of the canonical listing state. A group change closes the old state and opens a new one.

terms.description: Exchange trading terms valid for this listing. Terms are resolved at the decision date.

effective_from.description: First date these terms apply, inclusive.

effective_to.description: Last date these terms apply, inclusive. Null means open-ended.

effective_date.description: Effective date in exchange calendar time.

numerator.description: Adjustment numerator; both ratio terms are always required.

denominator.description: Adjustment denominator; both ratio terms are always required.

amount_paise.description: Per-share amount in paise where the action carries one (dividend/rights).

note.description: Free-form annotation from the source record.

tick_schedule.description: Price-linked exchange tick schedule valid for these terms.

bands.description: Ordered contiguous tick bands covering [0, +inf): lower bound inclusive, upper bound inclusive or null for the open-ended last band.

lower_paise.description: Inclusive lower price bound, in paise.

upper_paise.description: Inclusive upper price bound, in paise. Null only on the final, open-ended band.

tick_paise.description: Tick size for prices in this band, in paise.

tick_assignment.description: Assigned tick for this term interval, with the price-source and schedule lineage that makes it reproducible. NSE assigns tick sizes monthly per instrument from the previous month's last available close; the assignment is a record, never a live band lookup. A monthly assignment is detected by any monthly-lineage field being non-null, exactly as TickAssignment::validate() does.

reference_close_paise.description: Reference closing price, in paise, that fixed the assignment. Null for non-monthly assignments.

effective_month.description: First day of the month this assignment governs. Null for non-monthly assignments.

schedule_revision.description: Source revision the tick was assigned under (e.g. exchange circular or master format). Never blank.

reference_close_date.description: Trading date of the reference close. For NSE monthly assignments it must fall in the month immediately preceding effective_month.

reference_source.description: Dataset identity of the reference close (e.g. nse-eod-close). Required for monthly assignments.

reference_sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 of the exact reference-close source bytes. Required for monthly assignments.

schedule_effective_from.description: Date the exchange tick-schedule revision took effect.

schedule_sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 of the exact tick-schedule source bytes. Required for monthly assignments.

calendar_revision.description: Exchange-calendar source revision ({source_id}:{source_format_version}) that fixed the reference session. Required for monthly assignments.

calendar_sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 of the exact holiday-calendar source bytes. Required for monthly assignments.
